Package model.academic

Class Mark

java.lang.Object
model.academic.Mark
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Mark extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a student's mark for a specific course. Total = att1 + att2 + finalExam (max 100 points). Letter grade thresholds follow standard GPA scale.
